sources.name: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps (CHR&R), 2025 Annual Data Release — National Analytic Data CSV, measure v161 'Suicides'
sources.note: CHR&R's Suicides measure is DERIVED from NCHS/NVSS mortality files (National Center for Health Statistics — Detailed Deaths (Mortality), Multiple Cause of Death, states and all counties, 2016–2023 file), pooled over 2018–2022, joined to Census Bureau Population Estimates Program denominators. This is a substitute source, not a direct NCHS/WONDER pull — used because CDC WONDER's programmatic API structurally blocks county-level and state-level geography for National Vital Statistics System mortality data (confirmed directly against the live WONDER D76 API, which returned: 'Only national data are available for this dataset when using the WONDER web service... nor limit these location variables to any specific values.'). CHR&R's own suppression rule for this measure was independently verified against the underlying data: every non-suppressed county has a pooled 5-year death count of exactly 10 or more (verified programmatically, min numerator = 10, zero counties with numerator 1–9), consistent with the NCHS/CDC rule against publishing counts or rates based on 9 or fewer deaths.
